About Organization

The Delhi High Court is the highest court in the National Capital Territory of Delhi. It was established in 1966.

The Delhi High Court has jurisdiction over the National Capital Territory of Delhi and hears cases related to civil, criminal, and constitutional matters.

The Delhi High Court Higher Judicial Service HJS Recruitment 2026 is a government job opportunity for Indian citizens.

The programme aims to recruit eligible candidates for the post of Higher Judicial Service in the Delhi High Court.
